content: Maaron loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni ve iuluul zi

content.text: Lolomim poia pa Yoova ve apaiti. Pasaa, i poia le poia kat.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Lolomim poia pa Maaron ve apaiti. Pasaa, i iliiv zimaronŋa tisov.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Lolomim poia pani ve apaiti. Pasaa, i Maaron tiina tau iliiv zimaronŋa tisov.

content.text: I mon ta ighamgham gabua ŋgeretazi tau tintiina kat.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Muuŋ, i ighur gabua naol isov tau tighenaar ila sambam saamba. Uraat tooni tawe, ighamu toman ŋgar le ivot kat.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Ve ighur gabua tintiina tigheen ila sambam saamba to tigham nugh ighazooŋ.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Ve ighur kaiyo ve pitum, leso tisul pa mboŋ.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: I ta iravuur yes Isipa natuzŋa aidabazŋa.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Ve igham yes Israela tipul yes Isipa ve tivot.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Saawe tana, i itotoi tapiri tiina ivot ighazooŋ.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: I ivalagh te, gha sirivu ila pa ŋas, ve sirivu ila pa tapir, le taan gorgori ivot.

content.text: Ve igherev yes Israela, gha tilaagh ila taan mamaasa tau igheen bodbodaaŋ to te na, ve tila tivool ziige ite.

content.text: Ve igham Te Siŋsiŋai itav kinik to yes Isipa tomania zaaba tooni, le tisov tighun te gha timataar.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: I imuŋmuuŋ pa tamtamon tooni gha yesŋa tilaghlaagh izi nugh ŋginaaŋa.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Kinik tau ezazi tintiina na, i irav zi timatmaat.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: I irav Amora kinik toozi Sihon imaat.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Ve igham taan toozi imin yes Israela lezi motot.

content.text: Igham taan tawe pa yes Israela tau besooŋa tooni na, leso tileep pani taghon taghon gha ila.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Saawe tau koiaanŋa titatan ghiit le tavaghamgham, Maaron loolo iveegh pait mako.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content: I loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.

content.text: Tauvene lolomim poia pa Maaron to sambam, ve apaiti pa poia tooni!

content: Pasaa, i loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni, ve iuluul zi irau saawe.
